question: Can AO6 become more visibly film-stylized without severe artifacts by emphasizing only its non-basic Lab chroma residual relative to its own strongest fitted basic adjustment?

candidate.basic_family: per-image joint EV plus diagonal white balance plus contrast plus saturation fit to the deterministic AO6 output
candidate.domain: D65 CIELAB derived from encoded sRGB through the project linear-sRGB primitives

branches.automatic_fail: close BL13 without changing the residual strength, basic family, colour domain, thresholds or rails
branches.automatic_pass: open autonomous severe and three-round blind development review against unchanged AO6
branches.visual_fail: close BL13 and retain unchanged AO6
branches.visual_pass: retain BL13 only as a development challenger and require a new independent population before promotion

claim_ceiling: content-adaptive deterministic development Look Approximation on a consumed CC0 population; not independent preference, film truth, stock response, calibration or product promotion
